boundedQuestion: Can an independent-review receipt prove that an authorized verifier distinct from the producer reviewed the exact same subject and producer attestation?

teacher.name: in-toto layout + signed link metadata
teacher.exactNovelty: R2 states that Producer cannot approve itself; in-toto adds signed, layout-authorized functionary identities and artifact-chain binding that can make the separation executable rather than self-declared.

limits: Distinct keys prove cryptographic identities, not distinct humans; key issuance and custody remain operational requirements.
A valid verifier signature does not prove technical correctness, browser/GPU execution, competence, or user acceptance.
The probe uses generated local keys and a synthetic subject; it does not sign or approve R136.
